plan.title: Live-window shortening preserves an awardable bid

steps.note: Build the live-event prerequisite.
Use a single RFQ stage for bidding and allocation.
Give the event a unique searchable title.
Enable line-item configuration.
Provide one item whose bid can later be allocated.
Complete the required buyer fields.
Commit a short initial window; this is not the requested live-window shortening.
Supply a participant without inventing a vendor name.
Publish before submitting a bid.
Verify that a real project was created.
Submit one bid through the configured vendor account.
Verify the prerequisite bid was accepted.
Return to the buyer's event page.
Fallback only: close normally or await the original window, rather than claiming to shorten the live deadline.
Assert the closed-state portion of the oracle.
Reopen the closed event after checking its list status.
Assert the comparison grid still contains line items and bidding vendors.
Enter allocation on the closed event.
Demonstrate that the retained bid can actually be allocated.
Verify the sole item is selected for the sole bidding vendor without submitting an unnecessary award proposal.
